messages.subject: Re: R_isMethodsDispatchOn error
parts:
Please include your OS and an r script that causes this so we can reproduce the problem.

Sent from my iPod

On May 15, 2013, at 7:23, frie...@gene.com wrote:

Hi, All

I've been running rapache 1.2.2 under R 2.15 and just upgraded to 1.2.3 and R 3.0. I'm getting this error in my apache log at startup:

Error in .Call("R_isMethodsDispatchOn", onOff, PACKAGE = "base") :
  "R_isMethodsDispatchOn" not available for .Call() for package "base"
Internal Error! Error attaching rapache environment!

I can't find that call anywhere in the source code.

Any idea where this error is coming from?

Thanks,

Brad
